summary_short:

- (The Hindu dispatch).
summary_long: The Indian Space Research Organisation successfully conducted a 200-second flight-acceptance hot test of the upgraded CE-20 cryogenic engine at its Mahendragiri propulsion complex in Tamil Nadu.
